handoff_merge.proposal: Interpretation to confirm: "the two HANDOFF files" = the two live HANDOFF.md (docs/ root; projects/ongoing-maintenance/). Concatenate them under one H1 with an H2 per source (its original first heading kept verbatim, with an italic line giving the source path and its last-touch commit), write the result to the target, and git rm both sources. Nothing is dropped; git history keeps each original. The other two (HANDOFF-l6-resilience.md is a completed-campaign tombstone; HANDOFF-engine-qualify-seats.md says it is a different line "do not overwrite") are plain renames into project/handoff/. References to either merged source are rewritten to the target.

index_split.proposal: Keep the preamble, "進行中" and "規劃中" in project/projects/INDEX.md (the live queue). Every other section (已完成, Fix ships, 歷史債, 歸檔) goes to project/projects/_archive/<YYYY>/INDEX.md by the row date (all current rows are 2026, so one 2026 file unless a month split is wanted), headings and table headers repeated verbatim, and the live INDEX ends with a link list to the yearly files. This is a MECHANISM change, not a rename: check-plan-graduation.js reads one projects_index and archiveIndexRow flips a row from in-progress to archived inside that file, so a row now crosses files. Consumers to adapt in a separate commit: check-plan-graduation.js, preflight-release.sh, check-phase-review-receipt.js, dispatch-plan-review.js, scaffold-mission.js. Links into ../plans/ are rewritten by the reference rewriter like any other.
